title: Influence bound implies noise sensitivity bound
statement: Let $B=(B_n)_{n\ge0}$ be a family of sets of real-valued functions on Boolean cubes, and let $A:\mathbb N\to\mathbb R$. Suppose every function in every $B_n$ is $\pm1$-valued, the family is closed under every substitution $w\mapsto(z_i+w_{\pi(i)}\bmod 2)_{i=1}^n$ for all dimensions $n,m$, vectors $z\in\{0,1\}^n$, and maps $\pi:[n]\to[m]$, and every $f\in B_n$ has total influence at most $A(n)$. For $0<\delta\le\tfrac12$, every $n\ge0$, and every $f\in B_n$, the noise sensitivity defined by $\operatorname{NS}_\delta(f)=(1-\operatorname{Stab}_{1-2\delta}(f))/2$ is at most $A(\lfloor\delta^{-1}\rfloor)/\lfloor\delta^{-1}\rfloor$, where $\lfloor\delta^{-1}\rfloor$ is the natural-number floor used as the block count.
hypotheses_covered: A dimension-indexed family $B$ of real-valued Boolean-cube functions
Closure of $B$ under all input negations and coordinate identifications
Every member's total influence is at most $A(n)$ in dimension $n$
replaced:
Let $B=(B_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ be a family of sets of functions $\{0,1\}^{n}\to\{-1,1\}$, closed under all substitutions $w\mapsto(z_i+w_{\pi(i)}\pmod2)_{i=1}^{n}$ for every $n,m\in\mathbb N$, $z\in\{0,1\}^{n}$ and map $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$, and let $A:\mathbb N\to\mathbb R$ satisfy
\[
\operatorname{Inf}(f):=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\Pr_X[f(X)\neq f(X^{\{i\}})]\leq A(n)
\quad\text{for every }n\in\mathbb N,\ f\in B_n,
\]
where $X$ is uniform on $\{0,1\}^{n}$ and $X^{\{i\}}$ flips coordinate $i$.
Then for every $0<\delta\leq1/2$, $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f\in B_n$, setting $m=\lfloor1/\delta\rfloor$ gives
\[
\operatorname{NS}_{\delta}(f)\leq\frac{A(m)}{m},
\]
where $\operatorname{NS}_{\delta}(f)=\Pr[f(X)\neq f(Y)]$ and $Y$ independently flips each coordinate of $X$ with probability $\delta$.
